item.title: ADHD & Neurodevelopmental Training
item.description:
ADHD & Neurodevelopmental Training Program

Train attention regulation, impulse control, and executive function — with or without medication.

Through neurofeedback, Interactive Metronome, and sensory integration, we strengthen the brain’s self-regulation capacity and aim for improved performance in daily life and academics.

Training Modalities

  • Neurofeedback: Real-time EEG feedback for self-regulation of target frequency bands
  • Interactive Metronome: Auditory timing training to improve attention, sequencing, and executive function
  • Sensory Integration: Balance, coordination, and sensory processing training

Target Population

  • Children and adolescents diagnosed with ADHD
  • Those seeking non-pharmacological or combined training
  • Individuals needing improvement in attention, impulsivity, and executive function

All programs are individually designed based on prior assessment and consultation.

item.title: Adult Peak Performance
item.description:
Adult & Professional Peak Performance Program

Enhance focus, stress regulation, and decision-making ability for working professionals.

Chronic stress, burnout, sleep problems, and decision fatigue are closely linked to reduced regulatory capacity of the brain and autonomic nervous system.

Training Modalities

  • HRV Biofeedback: Real-time heart rate variability monitoring, autonomic balance and stress resilience training
  • Neurofeedback: Focus, cognitive flexibility, and emotional regulation training
  • tVNS (Vagus Nerve Stimulation): Parasympathetic activation, relaxation and recovery enhancement

Target Population

  • Professionals experiencing burnout or chronic stress
  • Those with reduced focus and decision fatigue
  • Individuals seeking improved sleep quality and resilience

All programs are individually designed based on prior assessment and consultation.

item.title: High-Functioning Children & Peak Performance
item.description:
Gifted Children Peak Performance Program

We analyze and optimize cognitive profiles so that high potential translates into actual performance.

Performance in music and mathematics is not merely about knowledge accumulation — it is a function of flow state entry, arousal regulation, error recovery, and emotional-cognitive control.

Training Modalities

  • Neurofeedback: Flow state (theta/alpha) entry and maintenance training
  • Biofeedback (HRV): Autonomic nervous system balance and pre-performance arousal regulation
  • Peak Performance Protocol: Individually designed based on cognitive profile

Target Population

  • Gifted children and adolescents in music and mathematics
  • Those with high potential but underperforming
  • Individuals experiencing test anxiety, performance anxiety, or perfectionism

All programs are individually designed based on prior assessment and consultation.
